usage.callShape: GET https://pro-api.coingecko.com/api/v3/x402/onchain/simple/networks/{network}/token_price/{address} — no query params required; network and token contract address are path segments
usage.outputShape: body.data.data.attributes.token_prices.<address> — USD price as a string, or null if CoinGecko has no onchain price data for that contract; body.data.data.type is always 'simple_token_price'
quirks: token_prices.<address> may be null for contracts not tracked by CoinGecko onchain data — this is a valid 200 response, not an error; callers must handle null
Two backend URL patterns exist: one with :address path param on Monad network and one with address embedded in the URL on Base — both cost $0.01/call and accept x402 on Base or Solana
No query parameters are needed or supported; all input is via path segments (network slug + contract address)
usage.guide: Call GET with the network slug and ERC-20 contract address as path segments; no body or query params are required. Pay $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. The response JSON is at body.data.data.attributes.token_prices.<address> and holds the USD price as a string, or null if the contract is not tracked. Always check for null before using the price — a null price is a valid 200 OK response, not an API error. Supported networks include 'base', 'monad', and 200+ others; substitute the network slug in the path. For the Monad backend, the URL ends in token_price/:address (replace :address with the actual contract); for Base, a pre-baked URL with a fixed contract is also available.
